# FIX-03: a stock check before each order is confirmed

INVENTED TEST FIXTURE: a fictional request from the fix window, too big for a change order.

The operations manager asks that each order be checked against the stock the warehouse holds before it is confirmed, and that a short order be flagged to the customer the same day. Today the warehouse keeps stock on a whiteboard; there is no stock system.

Classified as a change: the agreed scope confirms orders, it does not check stock. It needs a new system (stock records), so it goes to a new Build Plan.
